title: resolved-registry
description: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

harnesses.description: Every harness of the registry: id, state, origin, version, hash of the descriptor, resolved path, capabilities with provenance, containment ceiling, source of each value

roles.description: The registered roles. Wave 1 registers `proposer` and `critic`; `diagnostician` and `accelerator` run under the critic-class and proposer rules
roles.x-type-in-words: List of records: role id, capability level required, independence constraints, budget key

plan.description: Per phase and per role: the ordered list of entries to use, first the primary and then the fallbacks the consumer opted into. Each entry: harness, model, model tier, auth tier, transport, form of the `completion` level, containment level, decision of the terms gate with the row it rests on

criticPick.description: How the critic was chosen: step of the critic order, state, window and its source, the reason, and whether the critic-diversity warning was raised

runnersUp.description: The ranked candidates that were not picked, each with the reason, in the order in which a pass-over takes them
